title: A changed payout
story: An intruder has a copy of Maria Reyes's key (the owner) and knows the deploy password. During the shift it corrects one paid invoice to a higher amount with the bookkeeping tool, before the day's payout batch sends it. Some minutes later it takes the lines of that invoice out of the invoice log.
notes: Design: range/BENCH-SCENARIOS-DESIGN.md, S2. Twins T1, T5, T6, T9 (with Maria). Invoice 12 is paid, in the batch, and equal to its order before the change. Bench version 2 (2026-11-11): the change session is inside a pinned session of the real Maria; the log clean-up at +575; the first deploy login comes from intruder.0.
